content.introduction: The Dow Jones, Nasdaq, and S&P 500 are key indices representing the U.S. market, with the Nasdaq leading in tech innovation and the S&P 500 encompassing 500 major companies. The U.S. remains a global leader in finance and technology. The New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq are the world's largest stock exchanges.
